format: Pokémon GO (PGO, 2022): cards not already in the pool. Regulation mark F: Expanded.

attacks.name: Summoning Aroma
attacks.text: Look through your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Loopy Lasso
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. On heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon, and the new Active Pokémon becomes Asleep and Poisoned.

abilities.name: Sunny Bloom
abilities.text: Once at the end of your turn (after your attack), you may use this Ability. Draw cards until you have 4 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Pollen Hazard
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Burned, Confused, and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Growing Tall
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, look through your deck for up to 5 Grass Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Head Swing
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison String-Up
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tail on Fire
attacks.text: Look through your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Burn Brightly
abilities.text: Each basic Fire Energy attached to your Pokémon provides 2 Fire Energy. You can't apply more than 1 Burn Brightly Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Flare Symbol
abilities.text: Your Basic Fire Pokémon's attacks, except any Moltres, do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (before Weakness and Resistance)

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Split Bomb
attacks.text: Does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Vitality Spring
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look through your deck for up to 6 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 30 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Pump Shot
abilities.text: You must discard a Water Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Torrential Cannon
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Torrential Cannon.

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ideal Fishing Day
attacks.text: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Tumbling Tackle
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon become Asleep.

attacks.name: Twilight Inspiration
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if your opponent has exactly 1 Prize card remaining. Take 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Lively Grouping
attacks.text: Look through your deck for any number of Magikarp, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Raging Fin
attacks.text: Does 30 more damage for each Magikarp and Gyarados in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Wreak Havoc
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Wild Splash
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Ice Symbol
abilities.text: Your Basic Water Pokémon's attacks, except any Articuno, do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (before Weakness and Resistance)

abilities.name: Punk Out
abilities.text: If your opponent has any Pokémon V in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: First Impression
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, it does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Buddy Bolt
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, it does 30 more damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Symbol
abilities.text: Your Basic Lightning Pokémon's attacks, except any Zapdos, do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (before Weakness and Resistance)

attacks.name: Transfer Break
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pinpoint Wave
attacks.text: Does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon V. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Souvenir
attacks.text: Look through your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Wonder Flash
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Dragon Pokémon, it does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Rock Tomb
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Raging Swing
attacks.text: Does 50 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 10 more damage.

attacks.name: Crashing Bullet
attacks.text: Also does 20 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Counter
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does that much more damage.

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 90 more damage, and your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Chase Up
attacks.text: Look through your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Super Fang
attacks.text: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.

attacks.name: Raging Crash
attacks.text: Does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Iron Buster
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Swinging Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Does 90 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Arm Charge
attacks.text: You may attach a Metal Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: G-Max Juggernaut
attacks.text: Does 60 more damage for each extra Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon (in addition to this attack's cost). You can't add more than 120 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Draconic Star
attacks.text: Look at the top 12 cards of your deck and attach any number of Water or Lightning Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. (Only 1 VSTAR Power per game.)

attacks.name: Delicious Egg
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Enriching Egg
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

abilities.name: Block
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Collapse
attacks.text: This Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Bustle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Primate Dexterity
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. On heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Full Tilt Fling
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. Does 60 damage for each heads.

abilities.name: Kinda Lazy
abilities.text: If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 Prize cards remaining, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Reassuring Dam
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, cards in your deck can't be discarded by effects of your opponent's attacks, Abilities, Item cards, or Supporter cards.

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Hurricane Wing
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. Does 70 damage for each heads.

cards.name: Blanche
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, flip a coin. On heads, attach a Water Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Candela
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, flip a coin. On heads, attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Egg Incubator
cards.text: Flip a coin. On heads, look through your deck for a Basic Pokémon, put it onto your Bench, and shuffle your deck. On tails, put this Egg Incubator on the bottom of your deck instead of in the discard pile.

cards.name: Lure Module
cards.text: Each player reveals the top 3 cards of their deck and puts all Pokémon they find there into their hand. Then, each player shuffles the other cards back into their deck.

cards.name: PokéStop
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard 3 cards from the top of their deck. If a player discarded any Item cards in this way, they put those Item cards into their hand.

cards.name: Spark
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, flip a coin. On heads, attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
